changes: Brings in upstream octabam's newer Modulation code: it uses less DSP time in every mode except PHSR, and its delay loops can no longer hold up the instrument's other audio work.
The sound and the controls are unchanged; saved projects load as before.
Adds a package so the Modwerk base can load it over USB.
Known issue: loading over USB is not yet tested on a unit. With two tracks in different modes, the knob names show the last mode set until you open the second page.
Known issue: stays paused in the library until the owner reinstates it.
Documentation-only: correct copyright notices, component licence terms and SPDX metadata. No DSP implementation changed.
First Modwerk catalog release of the FX1 modulation effect, with JUNO, DIM, FLNG, COMB and PHSR modes.
